Method of Attack: Roots devices and infects Zygote, a core Android OS process, making removal almost impossible without wiping the device and reinstalling the OS
Infecting users with Android.MulDrop adware via an Android app with over 1 million downloads on Google Play Store
Impacted Systems: Over 40 models of low-cost Android smartphones including Leagoo, Doogee, Vertex, Advan, Cherry Mobile, and others
Android devices globally including Russia, Poland, Indonesia, China, Czech Republic, Mexico, Kazakhstan, Serbia
Attack Vector: Pre-installed malware on newly shipped devices via a software developer from Shanghai injecting trojan code into system libraries before compilation
Malicious application signed with the same certificate used in previous malware campaigns
Indicators of Compromise: List of infected smartphone models such as Leagoo M5, Leagoo M5 Plus, Leagoo M8, Leagoo M9, Doogee X5 Max, Cherry Mobile Flare S5, and others
